changed: On a tablet or computer, a dance's title bar keeps a labelled Perform button, Share and Add to program; the dialect choice, Duplicate, Re-import and Delete move into the ⋮ menu, with Delete last.
The Progression and Rating fields now stack on a phone so the five rating stars stay on one line.
A program's status (Draft, Finalized, Performed) now appears as a plain line under its title instead of a button-like chip.
On a phone the theme gallery shows two columns of theme cards (one column at larger text sizes), and the default themes are listed Light, Dark, Soft dark, High contrast.
Difficulty levels, custom-field choices and matrix columns now have Move up and Move down buttons beside each item, as well as drag handles.
A figure you have cut stays at full strength and is marked with a dashed outline and a Cut label instead of fading.

Small icon buttons on program slots, figure rows and the program matrix, and the bold and underline buttons for notes, are now full-size touch targets on phones and tablets, and the matrix's hide-column eye is no longer faded.
Dance and program rows share one title style, and dropdown values in the dance and program editors use the same weight as typed text.
The search box in the Add a dance picker is labelled Find a dance, so the label is no longer cut off on a phone.
fixed: Adding a dance to a program from the picker no longer sends focus back to the Title field and reopens the keyboard over the slots and the Added message.
In the colour dialog, Apply now uses the hex code you typed even if you did not press Enter, and says so when the text is not a six-digit colour.
